purpose: Showcase 4 product surfaces in a bento grid with looping demo video

responsive.phone: Media elements are laid out in-flow (bare/tablet defaults), each card full width, no CSS grid.
responsive.tablet: Media elements switch to absolute positioning within their card for the overlap effect (tablet:absolute tablet:top-0 tablet:right-0 tablet:w-[80%] or similar per-item overrides); heading steps to tablet:text-h3-t.
responsive.desktop: Whole section switches to an explicit CSS grid (desktop:grid desktop:grid-cols-[repeat(...)] desktop:grid-rows-[repeat(...)]) with individual cards spanning multiple columns/rows (desktop:col-span-2, desktop:col-span-3) -- a structurally different layout mode from phone/tablet's stacked-card approach, not just a resize.
